reuse.why: All affected consumers reuse the shared scheduling policy, recurrence conversion, and existing date utilities.

duplication.why: Weekend and holiday decisions are centralized, including removal of the budget consumer's repeated adjustment block.

placement.why: Scheduling policy remains in shared/schedules.ts, configuration in the model, and handler orchestration in the server scheduling module.

scope.why: The edits are confined to the requested scheduling extensions, their consumers, tests, and release note.

maintainability.why: The shared policy is straightforward, although separate occurrence-search bounds in getNextDate and getUpcomingDates introduce maintenance coupling.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Existing adjustment consumers and the new range handler all call applyWeekendRule.

disguised_duplication.where: The renamed adjustment helper consolidates the decision rather than concealing copied logic.

abstraction_drift.where: The replacement shared adjustment interface adds skipWeekend, frequency, and holidays alongside the existing direction setting, with one daily-frequency branch; these extensions directly represent the requested rules.
